checks: Held stale history replays a revisioned eviction into the real App transcript
An open image dialog retires to the connected, named attachment fallback with focus
An inactive ordinary owner loses only its cached image preview; metadata remains on revisit
Closing a still available image returns focus to its preview button
Retiring a closed image in an inactive owner does not steal composer focus
limitations: Synthetic Vite preview API and attachment events; no native IPC or device file read.
The two pages are independent renderer fixtures, not an Electron multiwindow fanout proof.
